title: Satisfiability under Tseitin conversion
statement: Let $\psi$ be a conjunctive normal form of width at most $w$, where $w\geq 3$, and let $x$ be an assignment to its original variables. The formula evaluates to $-1$ on $x$ if and only if there exist assignments to the $(w-3)$ auxiliary variables allocated per clause and to three further padding variables such that the three-literal Tseitin conversion evaluates to $-1$ on the combined assignment.
hypotheses_covered: Assignment to the original n variables
